verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਸੰਧਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਆਤਮ ਅਵੇਸ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਤਮ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat liv gur sikh sa(n)dh mile aatam aves pramaatam prabeen hai ||

en.bdb: With the union of a disciple coming in the refuge of True Guru and when his mind is engrossed in the divine word, he becomes an adept in uniting his self with the Supreme soul.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਤੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਤ ਸ੍ਵਾਂਤ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਕਤਾਹਲ ਹੁਇ ਪਾਰਸ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਕੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: tatai mil tat savaiaa(n)t boo(n)dh mukataahal hui paaras kai paaras parasapar keen hai ||

en.bdb: As the mythical rain-drop (Swati) turns into a pearl when it falls on an Oyster shell and becomes highly valuable, so would a person uniting with Supreme become like Him. Like philosopher-stone, the True Guru makes a Sikh like Himself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪਕੈ ਦਿਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧੀਅਤ ਆਪੈ ਆਪਾ ਚੀਨ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jot mil jot jaise dheepakai dhipat dheep heerai heeraa bedheeat aapai aapaa cheen hai ||

en.bdb: As an oil lamp lights the other, so does a true devotee (Gursikh) meeting with True Guru becomes an embodiment of His light and shines in the diamond like a diamond. He reckons his self then.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਗਤਿ ਚਤਰੁ ਬਰਨ ਜਨ ਕੁਲ ਅਕੁਲੀਨ ਹੈ ॥੨੨੫॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan banaasapatee baasanaa subaas gat chatar baran jan kul akuleen hai ||225||

en.bdb: All the vegetation around a sandalwood tree becomes fragrant. Similarly the people of all the four castes become of higher caste after meeting with True Guru. (225)
